english.note: Use 打斷 as the all-purpose verb for interrupting a person, action, or process.

exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 daa2 dyun6 ngo5 zou6 gan2 je5

english.note: Use this when an action, speech, or activity is interrupted before it can continue normally.

exampleSentences.jyutping: m4 hou2 daa2 dyun6 ngo5 gong2 je5

english.note: Use this when breaking means interrupting an action, conversation, or continuing process.

exampleSentences.english: Don’t break my train of thought.
exampleSentences.jyutping: m4 hou2 daa2 dyun6 ngo5 gong2 je5
